appys.label: Dragonwilds
appys.title: World Management
appys.description: Move between local, connected, and hosted Worlds while preserving the active profile.

cards.title: Ashen Hollow
cards.body: A private World with a verified save, selected character, and profile-aware mods.

cards.title: The Gilded Path
cards.body: A fingerprint-aware Sync destination with public-safe requirements and reviews.

cards.title: Preview Host
cards.body: A hosted profile with runtime, Sync listener, and heartbeat status.

cards.title: Keep contexts separate
cards.body: Worlds, characters, mods, and launch policy stay associated with an intentional profile.

appys.label: Profile
appys.title: Profiles & Characters
appys.description: Review the active player profile, associated character saves, and recoverable operations.

cards.title: Active save
cards.body: The selected character is hydrated from an exact save path before any editor opens.

cards.title: World context
cards.body: Character and World associations help every downstream Appy select the correct data.

cards.title: Export profile
cards.body: Create a bounded portable package without exposing machine secrets or unrelated saves.

cards.title: Restore safely
cards.body: Use application backups or trash entries before repeating a failed write.

appys.label: Mods
appys.title: Mod Management
appys.description: Use one canonical master repository while allowing explicit profile-specific copies.

cards.title: Canonical library
cards.body: Edit reusable payloads without silently overwriting deployed profile copies.

cards.title: Preview Profile mods
cards.body: Change only this profile, or explicitly pull the canonical version from Master.

cards.title: Community mod placards
cards.body: Browse banner-based recommendations with Nexus Mods or Steam source identities.

cards.title: Profile-specific policy
cards.body: Activation, tags, and load order can vary even when payloads share a repository source.

appys.label: RSDW-L
appys.title: Editors & Preview
appys.description: Explore guarded Character, Item, Recipe, Quest, map, and runtime tools.

cards.title: Appearance and equipment
cards.body: Draft appearance changes, then click See changes to refresh the stable 3D preview.

cards.title: Canonical inventory
cards.body: Vanilla and modded records share one normalized identity repository.

cards.title: Spells, recipes, quests
cards.body: Inspect supported records while preserving unknown fields and bounded write behavior.

cards.title: Map and console
cards.body: Preview-only and runtime-affecting actions are clearly separated by target and confirmation.

appys.label: Sync
appys.title: Connection & Sync
appys.description: Resolve identity, compare manifests, transfer approved differences, and verify the result.

cards.title: Fingerprint trust
cards.body: Bind the session to the expected endpoint instead of trusting a display name alone.

cards.title: Required changes
cards.body: See exactly which bounded profile content differs before accepting a transfer.

cards.title: Private endpoint
cards.body: Connect explicitly without public listing while retaining authentication and identity checks.

cards.title: Launch boundary
cards.body: The game becomes launch-ready only after final manifest verification succeeds.

appys.label: Hosting
appys.title: Server & WebHost
appys.description: Materialize a hosted profile, supervise its runtime, and publish only verified state.

cards.title: Runtime materialization
cards.body: Bring together the intended save, configuration, mods, and dedicated runtime revision.

cards.title: Public-safe projection
cards.body: Publish bounded World details and expiring fingerprint-verified heartbeats.

cards.title: Independent control
cards.body: Authenticated remote administration remains separate from website publication.

cards.title: Start and stop verification
cards.body: Process ownership and cleanup are verified rather than inferred from a button click.

appys.label: Helpy
appys.title: Helpy Documentation
appys.description: Search the same GitHub-managed system guide used by both website and application.

cards.title: help/manifest.json
cards.body: Update structured content once and publish it to both the website and embedded Appy.

cards.title: Screenshot placeholders
cards.body: Every system guide names suggested files and turns into a zoomable image when supplied.

cards.title: Find concepts quickly
cards.body: Search titles, summaries, workflows, troubleshooting text, and screenshot descriptions.

cards.title: Packaged fallback
cards.body: The desktop keeps a bounded fallback when the published website cannot be reached.

appys.label: Settings
appys.title: Application Settings
appys.description: Control themes, paths, integrations, update policy, backups, and advanced behavior.

cards.title: Dark, White, and Glass
cards.body: Choose a color foundation and apply Glass as an independent atmospheric treatment.

cards.title: Installation and storage
cards.body: Validate game, save, runtime, and repository locations without silently moving content.

cards.title: Connected services
cards.body: Nexus Mods, Steam, Discord, and networking tools expose separate capabilities and status.

cards.title: Updates and recovery
cards.body: Review versions, diagnostics, backups, trash, and scoped recovery actions.
